title: רב פפא בר אבא רישבא

paragraphs: Rav Pappa bar Abba, the fowler. They came before R' Abba, who said to them: Hullin 54a. Yuhasin did not include him. It seems that he was not a sage, and it should read ‘those of Pappa bar Abba the fowler's household,’ rather than ‘Rav Pappa.’ This is learned from the context: just before this it says, ‘Those of Yosef the fowler's household struck the sciatic nerve; they came before R’ Yehudah ben Beteira, who said to them,’ etc. The language also precisely indicates this, for it says ‘they came’ in the plural, when it would have had to say ‘he came’; similarly ‘he said to them’ would have had to be ‘he said to him.’ Understand this. R' Abba the priest, bar Pappa.
